description: This file manages abort-related functionalities in an auto-reply system, including session management, abort request detection, and cascading sub-agent termination.

methods.name: formatAbortReplyText
methods.description: Generates a reply text indicating the number of sub-agents stopped after an abort request.

methods.name: resolveSessionEntryForKey
methods.description: Resolves a session store entry and its key(s) for a given session key.

methods.name: resolveAbortTargetKey
methods.description: Determines the target session key for an abort operation based on message context.

methods.name: normalizeRequesterSessionKey
methods.description: Normalizes a session key for a requester based on configuration.

methods.name: stopSubagentsForRequester
methods.description: Stops all subagents associated with a requester session key, including cascading sub-sub-agents.

methods.name: tryFastAbortFromMessage
methods.description: Attempts to quickly abort a session based on a message, handling session cancellation, queue clearing, and cascading sub-agent termination.
